criticalAlerts.name: Runtime Process Crash / Restart Loop
criticalAlerts.action: PagerDuty to On-Call Engineer, automatic container restart
criticalAlerts.remediationRunbook: Check /api/health logs, verify database/disk accessibility, inspect unhandled exception traces.

criticalAlerts.name: State Machine Illegal Transition or Terminal Resurrection
criticalAlerts.action: Notify AI Engineering Team, isolate affected bot instance
criticalAlerts.remediationRunbook: Verify state machine transition tables in src/conversation/stateMachine.ts.

criticalAlerts.name: Premature Promotion or Cooldown Bypass Detected
criticalAlerts.action: Enforce Promotion Lock (LockLevel=0), audit promotion policy
criticalAlerts.remediationRunbook: Check promotion policy evaluator cooldown timer and turn counters.

criticalAlerts.name: Telegram Downstream Circuit Breaker Open
criticalAlerts.action: Alert Telegram Integration Owner, throttle outbound requests
criticalAlerts.remediationRunbook: Check MTProto connectivity, FloodWait timeouts, IP rate limits.

warningAlerts.name: Engine Turn Latency p95 > 2.0ms
warningAlerts.action: Slack Notification to AI Performance Channel
warningAlerts.remediationRunbook: Profile normalizer regexes, check garbage collector pauses.

warningAlerts.name: Intent UNKNOWN / FALLBACK Rate > 10%
warningAlerts.action: Review unrecognized user utterances in telemetry logs
warningAlerts.remediationRunbook: Expand gold dataset and intent keyword patterns.

warningAlerts.name: CTA Effectiveness Drop > 25% Baseline
warningAlerts.remediationRunbook: A/B test prompt variations and promotional card creative copy.

warningAlerts.name: User Rejection Rate > 35%
warningAlerts.action: Inspect conversation transcripts for pushy promotion patterns
warningAlerts.remediationRunbook: Increase natural conversation turns before Level 1 soft mention.
